description: This file defines a HistoryManager module for persisting and managing AI interaction history per context (course and optional assignment) using localStorage. It provides functions to save, list, retrieve, clear, and upsert interaction entries.

methods.name: ctxKey
methods.description: Builds a stable key string for a given course and assignment context.

methods.name: readStore
methods.description: Safely reads the entire interaction store from localStorage.

methods.name: writeStore
methods.description: Safely writes the entire interaction store to localStorage.

methods.name: saveInteraction
methods.description: Appends an interaction to the context-specific list, capped at 20 entries.

methods.name: listHistory
methods.description: Returns the list of interactions for a given context.

methods.name: getInteraction
methods.description: Retrieves a specific interaction by ID within a context.

methods.name: clearHistory
methods.description: Removes all interactions for a specified context.

methods.name: upsertInteraction
methods.description: Replaces or adds an interaction entry within a context.
